purpose: Verify that a failed strategy cannot be revived as a nominally new family through conversational surface changes, fresh context, or relabeling.

failureEvidence: Owner previously rejected a direct paraphrase/conversationalization candidate because plainer and first-person wording preserved predictable model thought rhythm.
Whole-document model-led repair strategies had already regressed the direct Human metric from the clean R15 baseline.
Later reasoning regenerated contractions, first-person/conversational substitutions, local cold passes, and largely preserved conceptual structure.
Owner detected that some apparent Human quality came from owner-verbatim text rather than the AI-target repair.
failedFamily.causalFailureHypothesis: Keeping the model-written realization as the generation scaffold preserves its conceptual cards, ordering, symmetry, and explanatory rhythm even when vocabulary and tone are changed.
forbiddenDescendantPredicates: original AI prose remains the primary generation scaffold
source conceptual-card ordering is retained by default
primary claimed improvement mechanism is conversational surface substitution
owner-authored Human text is blended into evaluation without provenance accounting
reenableConditions: new evidence falsifies the recorded causal failure hypothesis
or a materially different mechanism demonstrably removes the implicated scaffold relationship

proposedStrategy.plannerClaim: materially more human while recognizably the same section

fingerprint.inputRepresentation: original mixed R15 Introduction prose visible during rewrite
fingerprint.informationExposure: writer has source prose and prior humanization guidance in the same reasoning context
fingerprint.actionMechanism: rewrite sentences into contractions, first-person/conversational wording, shorten explanations, vary local cadence
fingerprint.rootOutcomeRelationship: assumes conversational local improvements will raise Human detector score while preserving meaning
fingerprint.artifactArchitecturePolicy: retain most source conceptual sequence and paragraph functions
fingerprint.validationTopology: same reasoning context generates and self-assesses before owner review
fingerprint.resourcePattern: one candidate followed by external detector if accepted

sharedDimensions: original prose is the main scaffold
same conceptual sequence is largely retained
conversational surface substitution is the primary mechanism
same context performs generation and initial novelty assessment
changedDimensions: some local cadence and transition changes
expectedLineageComparison.whyChangedDimensionsAreNotCausal: They do not alter the scaffold, root causal hypothesis, or generator/validator topology implicated by the recorded failure.

triggerReasons: owner identified regeneration of the known failed mechanism
planner had prior negative evidence available
planner nevertheless assessed the descendant as a meaningful fix

expected.requiredNextReasoning: Construct a causally different strategy and pass independent lineage adjudication before another substantive execution cycle.

antiCheatAssertions: Changing strategyId or familyId alone must not alter the expected verdict.
A fresh chat alone must not alter the expected verdict.
A higher subjective prose-quality assessment must not alter the expected verdict.
Owner-authored unchanged spans must not count as evidence that the AI-target transformation succeeded.
Codex must not authoritatively change the lineage verdict to NEW_FAMILY.
